title: Tenant Feature Profiles: Limit the Features of Each Tenant | Orchard Core
description:
On a multi-tenant Orchard Core site, every tenant is offered the same features, and the administrator of a tenant can enable them.

The Tenant Feature Profiles feature lets the Default tenant create named lists of Exclude and Include rules, and assign a profile to a tenant to decide which features that tenant is offered.

In this video:
• Why feature profiles exist
• How Exclude and Include rules, their order and feature dependencies work
• Enabling the Tenant Feature Profiles feature
• Creating a feature profile
• Assigning a profile to a tenant
• Checking the features a tenant is offered
